# Pumps: conjugate gamma-Poisson hierarchical model
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_1.pumps
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model{
    for (i in 1 : N) {
        theta[i] ~ dgamma(alpha, beta)
        lambda[i] <- theta[i] * t[i]
        x[i] ~ dpois(lambda[i])
    }
    alpha ~ dexp(1)
    beta ~ dgamma(0.1, 1.0)
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
